P12-A (Tirumala 2): ICU corner cut-out joins the lower porch (10′ × 14′3¼″). Veranda, east forecourt, passage and house remain raised (±0′0″).
Drawing room completely unfurnished. Kitchen/living/dining connected without partition. ICU has south-headed recliner bed & corner table only.
